title: Vector case R^d: reduce to one dimension via linear functionals

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: The R^d statement needs an explicit reduction. For any v in R^d: if X1,...,Xn ~ F (on R^d) with sum X_i = n*mu a.s., then <v,X_i> ~ F_v (the law of <v,X>) is the SAME for all i, and sum_i <v,X_i> = n<v,mu> a.s. Hence F_v is n-completely mixable on R with center <v,mu>. If F in M_n(mu) and F in M_n(nu) on R^d, the 1-d uniqueness result gives <v,mu> = <v,nu> for every v in R^d, whence mu = nu. State and prove this reduction explicitly; verify that the 1-d marginal F_v is identical for all coordinates and that the a.s. constant-sum condition transfers. Low difficulty but required to cover the R^d part of the problem.
